name: Shadow Form Filler
description: Identity-first autofill with local audit trail and staleness detection. No passphrase, all data stays on device.

//permissions.storage: Encrypted IndexedDB for identity profiles, audit log, and crypto keys. No data leaves the device.
//permissions.sidePanel: Side panel UI for setup, audit log viewer, and per-site fill controls.
//permissions.activeTab: Inject the content script on user-initiated fill (icon click). Does NOT auto-fill on page load.
//permissions.scripting: Programmatic content script injection into iframes (all_frames: true) so forms in embedded frames are also detected.
//permissions.tabs: Read the active tab's URL/domain to display it accurately in the confirmation modal (no spoofing).
//permissions.webNavigation: Enumerate all frames in a tab so we can send fill/detect/edit-check messages to each frame's content script. chrome.tabs.sendMessage with frameId is the only way to target individual frames.

//host_permissions: <all_urls> is required for the universal form-filler use case. The user explicitly confirms every fill via the modal — we never auto-submit. The three API hosts are needed for the optional BYOK AI features (disabled unless the user provides a key). v0.4.5: the bundled test page is injected into the active tab via chrome.scripting.executeScript (the v0.4.4 data: URL trick was abandoned because Chrome rejects data: as a content_scripts match scheme). See SECURITY.md for threat model.

content_scripts.//matches: Runs on every real web page (via <all_urls>). The data:/* match that lets the bundled test page run the content script is injected by a Vite plugin (see vite.config.ts) — crxjs's match-pattern validator can't parse `data:/*` (it expects a host) so we add it after the fact.

//commands: F7 — keyboard shortcut to fill the active form. Default is Ctrl+Shift+F on Linux/Windows, Command+Shift+F on macOS. The user can rebind in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

fill_active_form.description: Fill the active form using the last-used profile
